name: Polar Twists #28
description:
A collection of individually twist-wrapped candies that resemble common peppermint sweets. The wrappers feature intricate designs of ice and snowflakes, and the candy inside is a translucent blue-green color.

EFFECT: After consumption, subjects report feeling cold or warm sensations unrelated to their surroundings, lasting approximately 45 minutes.
ANOMALOUS PROPERTIES: Modifies the body's perception of temperature, causing temporary chills or warmth regardless of the actual environment.
TASTE: A peculiar combination of mint and vanilla with a hint of metal.
PACKAGING: Brightly colored twist-wrappers featuring abstract ice and snowflake patterns. The words "Polar Twists" are printed in bold, icy letters with a small red warning symbol at the bottom.

RESEARCHER NOTE: Great for hot days or messing with coworkers' thermostats. Effect wears off in under an hour.

Dispensed by SCP-261 on 2026-11-24 — edition #28 of the permanent record.
